adoption_gates: Winner accuracy improvement AP vs noAP and 2026-inclusive vs historical-only must each have 95% CI lower bound above zero.
MAE increase must not be settled worse (95% CI lower bound must not exceed zero).
No market-beating or betting-edge claim without separate timestamped book benchmark and a settled interval.
Insufficient sample/zero-crossing CI means no adoption, keep candidates research-only and extend with a newly predeclared future week, never retune against Week7 outcomes.
